duration.details: Until the end of your next turn

description.baseEffect:
Tier 5 · 2 Actions · Range 6 · Blast 1.

Choose 2 areas in Range. Until the end of your next turn, creatures of your choice that enter one instantly appear on the other instead.
description.upcastEffect: Upcast: Range +2 or +1 turn duration. If 9 mana is spent, can be cast over 10 minutes. At the end of that time, you can place one area in Range and the second in a location you have been to before. These portals last 1 minute or until closed. Once you cast this spell this way, you must Safe Rest for 1 week before doing so again.
